text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children upon their parents, mentioning stories from the Islamic heritage about the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and their education. It clarifies the importance of dealing kindly with children and guiding them with rifq (gentleness) and wisdom. It also highlights the necessity of respecting children’s feelings and strengthening their self-confidence.
